```{r}


#CT_stops <- read.csv("C:/Users/Blake/Desktop/Stat 443/Midterm/Contraband-Traffic-Stops/data/CT_stops.csv")



CT_clean <- CT_stops %>%
  select(
    -driver_age_raw,
    -driver_race_raw,
    -violation_raw,
    -search_type_raw,
    -state,
    -stop_date,
    -fine_grained_location,
    -police_department,
    -location_raw,
    -stop_outcome,
    -is_arrested,
  )
names(CT_clean)
View(CT_clean)

```

```{r}
#Changing age into baskets
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
CT_clean <- CT_clean %>%
  mutate(
    driver_age_group = cut(
      driver_age,
      breaks = c(14, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 55, 60, 65, 150),
      labels = c(
        "15-20", "21-25", "26-30", "31-35", "36-40",
        "41-45", "46-50", "51-55", "56-60", "61-65", "66+"
      ),
      right = TRUE
    )
  )

ggplot(
  CT_clean,
  aes(x = factor(
    driver_age_group,
    levels = c(
      "15-20", "21-25", "26-30", "31-35", "36-40",
      "41-45", "46-50", "51-55", "56-60", "61-65", "66+"
    )
  ))
) +
  geom_bar(fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Driver Age Groups",
    x = "Driver Age Group",
    y = "Number of Stops"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()





```
```{r}
CT_clean <- CT_clean %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(
        driver_race,
        violation,
        search_conducted,
        search_type,
        contraband_found,
        driver_gender,
        county_name,
        stop_duration
      ),
      as.factor
    )
  )

# Check the updated column types
str(CT_clean)


```
```{r}
# Keep only stops where a search was conducted
CT_searches <- CT_clean %>%
  filter(search_conducted == "TRUE")


CT_searches %>%
  summarise(
    rows_remaining = n(),
    contraband_count = sum(contraband_found == "TRUE", na.rm = TRUE),
    fraction_contraband = mean(contraband_found == "TRUE", na.rm = TRUE)
  )

```
```{r}


# Count and calculate the percentage missing for every variable
missing_summary <- data.frame(
  variable = names(CT_clean),
  missing_count = colSums(is.na(CT_clean)),
  percent_missing = round(
    colMeans(is.na(CT_clean)) * 100, 2
  )
) %>%
  arrange(desc(percent_missing))

missing_summary

```
